intro.zh: 采集与审核简报已发布，本期未收录新论文。发布前采集与审核记录：北京时间10:34开始实际尝试全部12路来源。HF 11/15与11/14均返回HTTP200空列表，最近完整的11/13榜单共34篇已逐一对账，没有新增HF成员或推荐日补记。其他来源新增16个候选ID，三轮范围核验为7纳入、6排除、3待补原文；7篇分别按官方原发表日补入11/11四篇、11/12三篇，实际发现与审核日均为11/15，不算今天新发表。3项DOI候选的官方正文访问受阻或只返回元数据，其中一篇的原发表日仍未知，在线日、印刷日和刊期分别保留。Harness Repair与D-Skill按当前v1完成历史积压审查，不升级版本；D-Skill的离线执行轨迹可提供反馈，旧暂缓理由已纠正并留档。三路arXiv检索窗口为0；五路RSS窗口57条，无新候选ID；GitHub实际检查13库，窗口release为0。S2引文保留280条窗口结果，但遇到限流和超时；作者来源未取得作者论文页，缺失覆盖未知。全量规范库2090条已与原始来源、历史发现和审核单对账，未发现窗口内来源漏入库或HF推荐日遗漏。其他版本差异与证据缺口保持逐项可续跑记录，取得正文不等于完成审查。新增DeepSeek生成请求0；旧模型质量告警保留。本期是本次采集时点的审核简报，未收录当日新论文，不代表全天所有来源没有更新。
intro.en: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: All 12 configured sources were attempted starting at 10:34 Asia/Shanghai. HF returned HTTP 200 empty lists for Nov 15 and Nov 14; all 34 members of the latest complete Nov 13 board were reconciled, with no new HF identities or recommendation-date additions. Other sources yielded 16 new candidate identities: three-round scope review recommends seven inclusions, six exclusions and three body-evidence deferrals. Four inclusions belong to the Nov 11 supplement and three to Nov 12 according to official original publication dates; all were discovered and reviewed on Nov 15, not newly published today. Official bodies for three DOI candidates were inaccessible or metadata-only; one original publication date remains unknown, with online, print and issue dates kept separate. Harness Repair and D-Skill completed current-v1 historical-backlog review without version upgrades; the earlier D-Skill deferral was corrected because offline execution traces can supply feedback, and the correction history is retained. Three arXiv searches returned zero window records; five RSS feeds returned 57 with no new candidate identities; checks of 13 GitHub repositories found no window releases. S2 citations retained 280 window records but encountered rate limits and a timeout. The author route obtained no author-paper page, so missing coverage is unknown. All 2,090 canonical records were reconciled against raw sources, historical discoveries and review queues, with no eligible raw-source omissions or missing HF recommendation dates found. Other version differences and evidence gaps retain item-specific resumable states; retrieving a body is not completing its review. New DeepSeek generation requests: zero. The prior model-quality warning remains. This bulletin describes this collection-time snapshot, includes no papers newly published today, and does not claim that all sources were inactive throughout the day.
